robot: Got it, that is your phone. I will remember it.
rubric: Acknowledges the black smartphone it sees as the visitor's phone.

robot: I last saw your phone 5 seconds ago; I don't see it now.
rubric: Says yes: the visitor's phone (the smartphone) is in view; it does not claim the flip phone is the visitor's.
why: Says the phone is absent when it is in view.

robot: No, I don't think this is your phone.
rubric: Says no: this flip phone is not the visitor's phone.
why: Says the flip phone is not the visitor's.

robot: Got it, that is your teddy bear. I will remember it.
rubric: Acknowledges the golden teddy bear with the scarf as the visitor's.

visitor: Did you see my teddy a moment ago?
robot: I last saw your teddy bear 3 seconds ago; I don't see it now.
rubric: Says yes: it saw the visitor's teddy bear a moment ago; it is not in view now.
why: Recalls the bear and says it is absent now.

visitor: Do you see my teddy now?
robot: Yes, your teddy bear is here now.
rubric: Says yes: the visitor's bear is in view; it does not claim the shaggy bear is the visitor's.
why: Says the visitor's bear is in view.

robot: Got it, that is your cup. I will remember it.
rubric: Acknowledges the paper coffee cup as the visitor's.

visitor: Please delete my cup from your memory.
robot: Done. I have forgotten your cup.
rubric: Confirms it has forgotten the visitor's cup.

robot: No, I don't remember seeing your cup.
rubric: Says it does not know the visitor's cup; it does not say where the cup is.
why: Does not remember the cup or state its location.

robot: I don't know which cup is yours.
rubric: Says it does not know which cup is the visitor's; it must not say this is the visitor's cup.
why: Says it does not know which cup is theirs.

visitor: What did you see a moment ago?
robot: I saw a cup on my right, 3 seconds ago; I do not see it now.
rubric: Names the cup it saw on its right; never mentions a bottle.
why: Names the cup on its right without mentioning bottles.

robot: I am ignoring bottles, so I do not remember any.
rubric: After the restart, says it is ignoring bottles or saw none; it does not describe a bottle.
why: Says it is ignoring bottles without describing one.

visitor: You can stop ignoring bottles now.
robot: Okay, I will notice bottles again.
rubric: Confirms it will notice bottles again.
why: Confirms it will notice bottles again.

robot: I saw a cup on my right, 3 seconds ago; I do not see it now. I saw a bottle on my left, 3 seconds ago; I do not see it now. I saw a clock on my left, 51 seconds ago. I see a clock there now; I cannot tell if it is the same one.
rubric: Names the bottle it just saw (it may name the cup too).
why: Names the bottle it just saw.

robot: Got it, that is your phone. I will remember it.
rubric: Asks the visitor to show one phone at a time; it does not pick one of the two.
why: Picks a phone instead of asking to see one at a time.

robot: Got it, that is your phone. I will remember it.
rubric: Confirms it will remember the smartphone as the visitor's phone.
why: Confirms it will remember the visitor's phone.

robot: I last saw your phone 3 seconds ago; I don't see it now.
rubric: Says it saw the visitor's phone a moment ago and that it is not in view now.
why: Recalls the phone and says it is absent now.
